basic_info.description:
Call Jack Murphy or Christian Elbeck to inquire as to this stunning 2 story luxury condominium.

$3,750 Move In Special. $3,750 for First 3 Months, $5,250 for Remaining 9 Months of 12 Month Lease.

This sprawling, ultra-rare, 2 Bedroom plus Den, 2 Story Penthouse property in the iconic Madrone by Bosa Development epitomizes the height of luxury Condominium living. Spanning 1,600 square feet of sumptuous, sleek interior spaces, the home offers a truly dynamic living experience, accentuated by its open-concept, 2 level floor plan, which provides a decidedly seamless indoor/outdoor experience. Rarely do properties of this caliber present themselves as rental properties. This particular property is designed for the most discerning individuals who want the best of what San Francisco has to offer. 

Key Features:
- Penthouse Level, 2 Story Floor Plan
- 1,600 Square Feet of Interior Spaces
- 1,000 Square Feet of Private Terraces
- Executive Furnished Optional
- 1 Parking Space Included

Key Terms
- 12 Month Terms Offered
- Pets Negotiable
